text: Eva's driving test is May 14. She failed the first one on roundabouts and is really nervous this time. Text her good luck the night before.
Picked up the dry cleaning and dropped the parcel at the post office. Still need to renew the car insurance before the end of the month.
Yaw got his A-level results this morning: two A*s and a B. He's off to Leeds for engineering in September.

Had coffee with Zeynep. Her brother Karan is resitting his bar exam sometime next week and the whole family is on edge. Her mum has been cooking for him every night so he can just study, and her dad keeps quizzing him at dinner, which Zeynep says is not helping. Results are due early March. Karan apparently wants to move to Istanbul if he passes.
Louis mentioned his daughter has her grade 5 piano exam on June 3rd. He's more anxious about it than she is.
Dentist moved to 4/22 at 9:15. Book the morning off.
Michael and Anika are off to Lisbon for their anniversary early March. She found a little guesthouse near the river.
Call Tunde to ask how the audition went. It was Tuesday and I haven't heard anything.
Nora's dog Biscuit had his teeth out on Friday. He's fine now, just eating soft food and sulking.
Marisol has quit sugar, again. Mentioned it twice at lunch so I should probably not bring cake to the meeting on 11/7.
Dmitri finally passed his theory test! Third attempt. Practical is booked for 7/18.
Need to get a card for Uncle Femi's 70th. The party is end of the month at Chioma's, and I'm doing the desserts.

Rin is struggling with her dissertation. Her supervisor went on leave and nobody has replaced him. She says she's barely sleeping. Her partner Femi is away on a work trip until the end of the month, so she's on her own with the dog too. Her submission deadline is May 14 and she's thinking about asking for an extension. I should check in with her on Friday.
Return the library books, cancel the gym trial, and order new printer ink.
Mateo's sister Ana sat her nursing finals this week. Results come out sometime in August, and he says she won't talk about it until then.
Jamal says his son Kofi got into the county youth orchestra. First rehearsal is Saturday.
Henrik Jensen from the allotment group grows chillies, about twenty varieties. He's offered me some seedlings over the summer.
Remind me to message Layla on the morning of her citizenship test. It's March 9th, at the town hall.
Ahmed's wedding has been called off. He and Farah split up last month. Don't mention the venue to anyone.

Long call with Elif tonight. Her dad has a hip replacement booked for January 12 and her mum can't drive, so Elif is taking two weeks off to stay with them in Bristol. She's also got her CIMA exam on February 2nd, which she's now worried she won't be ready for. Check in with her after the op, and maybe offer to help with revision flashcards.
Mai Lee, everyone calls her Maisy, starts her teaching placement in Year 3 sometime next week.
Julien loves Formula 1. He's been dropping hints about a Ferrari cap, so that might be his birthday present.
Must book the MOT. The reminder said it's due 12/1 and the garage fills up fast.
Olga and her husband are hosting Thanksgiving this year, November 26. She asked if I could bring a pie.
Did Jaya hear back about the PhD interview? Ask her on Thursday.
Tadhg's little brother has his Junior Cert results early October. Tadhg says he's convinced he failed maths.
Marcus Osei is a radiographer at the General. He's thinking about moving to Manchester next year to be closer to his partner.

Chioma's twins sit their eleven-plus on September 14. She asked me to look after them for an hour the afternoon before so she can get her hair done. The boys are nervous, especially Femi, who froze in the practice paper last week. Their dad is away for work that whole week, so it's all on her.
Spent the afternoon sorting the spare room. Charity shop run on Saturday, then I'll paint it sometime in the next couple of weeks.
Uma said she's vegan now and can't stand mushrooms, which makes the dinner plan tricky.
Should send Femi a congrats message. He passed his CFA Level 2 and only told me today.
Karan's girlfriend Eva had her viva yesterday. Minor corrections only. They're celebrating at the weekend with her parents.

Anika says her son Louis is anxious about his driving test on 8/30. She's paying for extra lessons the week before, and her husband is taking him out every evening to practise. Louis already failed once in July, on a parallel park, and he's convinced the examiner hated him. Anika said he barely ate at dinner when they talked about it.
Grandma's flight lands at 6:40 on April 2. I'm picking her up.
Heard from Yaw that Tunde got the part! The callback was on 5/3 and he found out last night. Rehearsals start mid June.
Zeynep Yilmaz, my new manager. Two kids, runs half marathons, and drinks her coffee black. Very direct.
Kofi's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. He sounded exhausted. Don't forget to ring him at the weekend.
Jaya and Henrik are moving in together sometime in early spring. They viewed a flat in Clapton last week and loved it.
Rin's piano recital was cancelled because the hall flooded. They're hoping to reschedule for the end of the month.
Michael Brennan, Mikey to his rugby mates, is having knee surgery on October 30. He'll be on crutches for six weeks.
Nothing much today. Grocery shop, laundry, and an early night.
Farah just started a new job at the council planning office. Her first week was chaotic but she seems happy.
Text Marisol to see how her son's GCSE mocks went. He had English on Monday and maths on Wednesday.

Dmitri's grandmother died on Sunday. The funeral is next Friday in Gdansk and he's flying out on Wednesday. I should send flowers to his flat before he goes. His mum is already out there sorting things, and his sister Olga can't get time off work so she's only going for the day. He said they were very close; she taught him to cook.
Elif mentioned she collects vintage teapots. Has about forty. Good to know for Christmas.
Mateo's daughter has her black belt grading on June 21st. He keeps asking if I'll come and watch; I said yes.
Must finish the tax return by January 31. Find last year's P60 first.
Layla's cat Pepper went missing three days ago. Her kids are heartbroken and she's put posters all over the estate.
Ana is doing her ACCA papers in early December. Her boss is paying for it, but she has to pass everything first time or pay it back. No pressure then.

Coffee with Tadhg and Marcus. Tadhg is training for the Dublin marathon at the end of October, Marcus has given up running after his ankle surgery. Marcus's wife is due in February and they've just found out it's a girl.
I've booked the train to Edinburgh for 3/15 and I'm staying with Uma until the 18th.

Chat with Julien about his brother Henrik, who sat the police entrance assessment last month. He still hasn't heard back and Julien thinks he's starting to give up hope. Remind me to ask Julien next week if there's news.
Olga's son passed his driving test first time! She was thrilled, he was very casual about it.
Nora's daughter Mai has her ballet exam sometime next week. Nora is sewing the costume herself.
Buy stamps.
Jamal mentioned his wife Farah is pregnant again, due early May. Their eldest, Ahmed, wants a brother.

Anika's going through a rough patch: her mum's dementia has got worse and her brother isn't helping much. They're looking at care homes over the summer, and she's already visited two near Reading that she didn't like. Her husband Marcus has been great, apparently, but she's still doing most of the paperwork herself. I need to take her out for lunch soon, just to get her out of the house.
Yaw and his partner are doing a cooking class on 9/12 for her birthday. He wants ideas for a gift to go with it.

Karan has his medical school interview at Imperial on December 4th. He's been practising with his uncle, who's a GP. Wish him luck that morning, and then ask him how it went the next day. His mum says he's calm, but his sister Uma told me he's been rehearsing answers in the shower every morning. He also has a backup interview at Bristol sometime in January.
Need to pick up a birthday cake for Saturday, sort the gutters before the rain, and ring the council about the bins sometime this week.
